statements.status_notes: CVE-2018-6829: libgcrypt's ElGamal implementation (cipher/elgamal.c) does not encode plaintexts with semantic security, so an application that uses it to encrypt messages directly, rather than in hybrid mode, leaks information to a ciphertext-only attacker (https://github.com/weikengchen/attack-on-libgcrypt-elgamal). The reply on the libgcrypt list treats this as misuse by the calling application, since ElGamal is meant for hybrid encryption (https://lists.gnupg.org/pipermail/gcrypt-devel/2018-February/004401.html), and Debian rates it unimportant and unfixed, noting that GnuPG uses ElGamal only in hybrid mode: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2018-6829. The DHI Debian repository publishes libgcrypt20 for Debian 13 as a single rebuild of Debian's 1.11.0-7+deb13u1 (amd64 and arm64), whose shipped changelog adds no change beyond the rebuild. Its ElGamal code is unchanged, so an application that encrypts messages directly with it is still exposed. Pending: a decision on whether this owner is recorded as not affected because exploitation depends on an application using ElGamal outside hybrid mode, which needs a recorded maintainer decision, or as affected.
